name: create_task
title: Create a task
description: Create a task (a bug you found, a part of a split request, follow-up work). It starts unassigned in the first stage and starts no work. Make the description self-contained; if it came from another task, note the new key there with update_task. kind "theme" creates a theme (an epic).

kind.description: task (default) or theme: a card that groups other cards; no stage, no work.

theme_key.description: The theme the new card belongs to: an open card of kind theme in this project.

parent_key.description: Parent task in this project; must not itself be a subtask.

description.description: Markdown: what and why, and what done means (for a bug: steps to reproduce, expected and actual behaviour, environment). Mention the task it came from, if any.

relations.description: Relations of the new card to other cards, as add_relations of update_task. One refused relation refuses the creation.

task_key.description: The other card, in this project.

acceptance.description: The acceptance conditions of the card, one per item: each checkable on its own, so the assignee can mark it done with evidence and the reviewer confirm it.

complexity.description: Complexity points: 1, 2, 3, 5, 8 or 13 (split larger cards); null removes them.

complexity_reason.description: Reason for the complexity (1–300 characters); needs numeric points.
